name: Dev Server
description: Start Dev Server in a tab's or workspace's right-click menu: finds how the project runs and starts it in a new tab of that workspace. Knows package.json scripts (with the right package manager) and frameworks without one: Next.js, SvelteKit, Nuxt, Astro, Remix, SolidStart, Qwik, Angular, Expo, Gatsby, Eleventy, Create React App, Vue CLI and Vite. Also Deno tasks, Rails, Django, FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, Phoenix, Laravel, Hugo, Jekyll, Go, Cargo and Docker Compose.
author: Octet
